name: Glass Theme Pill Nav
useWhen: A project needs a warm glass pill navigation bar where an active capsule slides between items and a theme button changes the page mood.
source: User-provided WhatsApp screenshot of a glass pill nav and theme toggle clip with partial visible JavaScript.
implementationNotes: The active pill should move only after user selection, not autoplay.
Theme toggles must update CSS variables and then recalculate pill geometry.
Use enough contrast inside translucent glass surfaces.
Keep all targets large enough for touch and keyboard focus.
Do not use it as the only primary nav on dense enterprise screens without adaptation.
reducedMotion: Move the active pill instantly and keep the light/dark theme swap readable.
avoid: theme buttons with no real state change
